messages:
Priya Srinivasan: Heads-up — HarborCare sent back their vendor security questionnaire with a few outstanding asks: DPA confirmation, SOC2 evidence, KMS/key management details, and embedding retention policy. They call out PHI in use cases. I attached the filled form in the thread. Need owners and draft responses by EOD Thursday so we can do a legal review Friday. Who can triage gaps?
Marco Diaz: I can own KMS & DPA questions. Quick clarifying Q: which environments are in scope for HarborCare? Prod only or prod+staging?
Priya Srinivasan: Prod only (they'll integrate main inference endpoints + embeddings). Also they asked about logs/retention for S3 and whether we offer customer-managed keys for embeddings.
Sam O'Neill: I’ll pull the SOC2 artifact and the minimal evidence bundle. Where should I upload? Shared folder or copy to the ticket?
Lina Chen: Upload to the shared evidence folder and add a manifest. I'll export a short data-flow diagram from the console to include.
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Automated scan flagged the form as HIGH risk due to PHI mention in the use-case field — recommend priority handling.
Priya Srinivasan: Good catch. Marco — please note any parts that require Private/Dedicated vs Hosted. If CMK is only available for Dedicated/Private we need to be explicit.
Marco Diaz: Confirmed: CMK (customer-managed keys) supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys with HSM-backed encryption. I’ll capture exact wording and screenshots of the console options. Filing infra ticket for console screenshots: INFRA-4219.
Sam O'Neill: Found SOC2 report: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2025-redwood-report.pdf. I’ll copy a redacted PDF to the evidence folder and add hash + manifest.
Priya Srinivasan: Also need clear retention numbers for embeddings. Default retention is 90 days for hosted ingest, but we can offer configurable TTL for Dedicated/Private. Lina, can you draft a short table with retention by deployment type?
Lina Chen: On it. Draft will include: Hosted default 90d (customer can request shorter), Dedicated configurable per-tenant (90d/180d/custom), Private as per customer policy. Also proposing a DPA annex for embeddings to clarify retention and anonymization.
Marco Diaz: Note: key rotation policy — rotation cadence is 90 days for Redwood-managed HSM keys. For CMK we provide guidance; customers manage rotation via their KMS. I’ll add screenshot + reference to our KMS integration docs.
Sam O'Neill: Upload plan: /shared/harborcare-evidence/ — I’ll put SOC2, diagram, retention table draft, and a link to the INFRA ticket. Tagging legal for redaction review.
Priya Srinivasan: Timeline: assemble answers & evidence by COB Thu (2391234720), internal security/legal review Fri 09:00, send final responses Fri afternoon. Can everyone hit those windows?
Marco Diaz: Yes — planning to have KMS/DPA draft by Thu afternoon.
Sam O'Neill: SOC2 + evidence upload by Thu COB.
Lina Chen: Draft diagram + retention table by Wed EOD (can iterate).
legal-team: We can standby for Fri 09:00 review. Please include the draft DPA annex if you want faster turnaround.
Priya Srinivasan: Any blockers?
Marco Diaz: Need console access screenshot; INFRA-4219 created and assigned. Could be a small blocker if infra is slow.
Sam O'Neill: I'll redact internal IPs before upload and leave notes about redactions in the manifest.
Priya Srinivasan: Great. I’ll compile everything after uploads and do a final pass before legal. If anything stalls, flag here — HarborCare has a renewal check-in next Tue and they'd like this closed before then. :eyes: :thumbsup:
Lina Chen: Adding a suggested one-paragraph summary for customers: a short plain-language explanation of where keys live, retention defaults, and typical SOC2 artifacts. Will drop in the folder.
sec-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder scheduled: follow-up on Fri 09:00 for legal review.
Priya Srinivasan: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.
